name: humanizer-pro
description: Revise supplied drafts with your account, approved local preferences, review and writing reports.

interface.longDescription: Humanizer PRO helps writers plan and revise passages they supply. It supports general, academic and marketing revision through an authenticated local CLI. Optional approved global/project preferences guide mode selection and review; the service currently accepts only text, mode and supported style, so custom voice adherence is not guaranteed. Local detail checks compare numbers, links, quotations, negation and protected terms without calling the service. Users can explicitly save editable preferences and text-free session receipts, record acceptance feedback, export/delete local metadata, and generate private HTML reports. Reminder/report specifications require an approved supported local host scheduler; this package does not install a scheduler or rewrite in the background. Rewrites send the selected passage to Humanizer PRO and its disclosed processor, use existing account words and save private service history. Requested analysis returns uncertain signals without word deduction or service text history. OAuth and local writing metadata use separate private plaintext stores, not encryption. No telemetry, purchases, automatic recharges, automatic retries, arbitrary file reading or remote credential transfer. Requires local macOS/Linux, Node 20.11+ and a browser on the same computer.
defaultPrompt: Use Humanizer PRO to revise a passage I supply.
Check my Humanizer PRO word allowance.
